title: Signal: Dependency declared with a v-prefixed version
scope: A package.json file that declares a version written with a `v` prefix, which is a tag name rather than a semantic version.
limitations: It matches a version written with a `v` prefix, which is a tag name rather than a semantic version in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A `v` inside a git URL fragment is part of that URL and is not reported here.
